owner_request: Guarda este, porque mas adelante lo meteremos directamente en OpenBench, y pasa a la siguiente gran idea
hypothesis: Avoid constructing complete legal-move lists for existence and membership queries; this may recover substantial search throughput while preserving the exact generated lists, move order, rules and fixed-depth search results. Strength remains unproven until the timed panel.
scope: One shared generator, early exit for first legal move
Only validate king safety for the requested move in membership queries
Use boolean existence queries for terminal probes
No search pruning, NNUE, score, rule or normal move-order changes
validation_plan: Compare all four generation modes and order against hash-pinned PR7 generator across seeded walks
Exhaustively test all 65536 move encodings on castling, EP, promotion, pin and mate positions
Random membership probes and every legal move over the existing 9338-position walk
Debug/Release NNUE, points, mates and native interfaces
Require exact champion bench nodes twice in points and legacy
Eight alternating performance bench samples, depth12; report elapsed-time ratio, not Elo

panel.boundary: Displayed LOS100.0%/0.0%; complete pending pairs and recheck; resume within cap if boundary lost
panel.early_rejection: Owner-delegated manual neutral or clear loss rejection, with measured statistics preserved
panel.promotion: Only three valid WIN controls plus independent audits and qualified distribution/interfaces

constraints.PR9: Preserved independently for future OpenBench; not included in this candidate

reference_note: Upstream search uses legality/terminal probes; implementation here is based on the qualified Petrified generator, not ported upstream rules.
